subject: Combining two datasets with differing visit numbers

messages.author: eafa26121223327e
messages.subject: Combining two datasets with differing visit numbers
parts:
I have data from two different sets of years 2007-2010 and 2012 - 2017 that I'd like to model together as it will allow me to examine a broader geography. However, the data from 2007-2010 were collected using 3 visits and those from 2012 - 2017 using 2 visits. Is there a way to address this discrepancy in unmarked? Or am I pretty much out of luck from the get-go? 

Thanks,
KC

messages.author: 247b990d236a7af6
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Combining two datasets with differing visit numbers
parts:
The different number of visits should cause no problem (at least in using the program - but there is more bias in the estimators when there are just 2 visits compared to 3, however, and that depends on the value of the detection probabilities).  But your biggest concern might be the confounding of temporal and geographic effects.

Jim
